title: Tennessee Valley Authority 8-K Filing — Departure of CEO
summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority filed an 8-K on April 3, 2026, disclosing that President and CEO Donald A. Moul notified the TVA Board of his intention to retire on July 1, 2026. This is a standard corporate governance disclosure with no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Donald A. Moul, TVA President and CEO, announced retirement effective July 1, 2026
Filing dated April 3, 2026; Moul provided notice on that same date
Thomas C. Rice, Executive Vice President and CFO, signed the filing
TVA is a corporate agency of the United States created by an act of Congress
Filing does not contain any policy announcements, economic data, or market-relevant information
why_it_matters: This filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure regarding executive succession at a federal agency. It has no direct implications for monetary policy, interest rates, or financial market structure.
